display.purpose: Identity moments: hero wordmark and section headings. Never controls or body.

body.purpose: Everything interactive and readable; weight 300 base, 500-700 for emphasis.

label.purpose: Tab labels, stat captions, chips. 11px hard floor.

shadows.name: shadow-1
shadows.purpose: Resting cards. Ink-tinted, never pure black in light mode.

shadows.name: shadow-2
shadows.purpose: Hover lift (with translateY(-2px)) and score bars.

shadows.name: shadow-1-dark
shadows.purpose: Dark-mode resting cards; true black alphas.

motion.name: ease-calm
motion.purpose: Default ease-out for lifts, icon states, card transitions. No overshoot anywhere.

motion.name: duration-move
motion.purpose: Transforms and lifts. prefers-reduced-motion collapses all to 0.01ms.

breakpoints.name: wide-controls
breakpoints.purpose: Quiz filters 2->3 col; visuals and More hub 1->2 col.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one decisive action on a screen (Next question, Full mock).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #a85a38; color: #fff; padding: 9px 18px; border: none; border-radius: 12px; font-family: Outfit, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.01em; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #9d5233; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.96); background: #8f4c30; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #cc785c; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Supporting actions beside a primary (Reset score, Preview).
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: rgba(45,52,40,.05); color: #2d3428; padding: 9px 18px; border: none; border-radius: 12px; font-family: Outfit, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: rgba(45,52,40,.1); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.96); }

components.name: Card
components.description: The standard raised surface; lifts 2px on hover.
components.html:
Acute Care Cardiology
Covers ACS, heart failure decompensation, and arrhythmias.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #fffcf6; border-radius: 16px; padding: 16px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(45,52,40,.05), 0 2px 8px rgba(45,52,40,.05); transition: box-shadow .18s, transform .18s; font-family: Outfit, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(45,52,40,.07), 0 8px 20px rgba(45,52,40,.07); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-card-title { font-weight: 700; font-size: 1rem; color: #2d3428; } .ds-card-sub { font-size: 0.82rem; color: #5a6151; margin-top: 4px; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Tinted pill badge: domain, difficulty, volume, topic tags.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: #f3e3da; color: #a85a38; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 20px; font-family: Outfit, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Filter Chip (selected)
components.description: Selected state inverts to the solid hue.
components.css: .ds-chip-selected { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: #a85a38; color: #fff; padding: 5px 12px; border-radius: 20px; font-family: Outfit, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Filled Input
components.description: Borderless filled field used for search and filters.
components.css: .ds-input { background: rgba(142,142,147,.12); border: none; color: #2d3428; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 12px; font-family: Outfit, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.82rem; outline: none; transition: background 0.15s; width: 220px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #8a8e80; } .ds-input:focus { background: rgba(142,142,147,.2); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #cc785c; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Icon Chip
components.description: Signature identity atom: tinted rounded square holding a 1.6-stroke SVG section icon.
components.css: .ds-icon-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 12px; background: rgba(91,110,168,.16); color: #5b6ea8; } .ds-icon-chip svg { width: 60%; height: 60%; }

components.name: Tab Button
components.description: Bottom-bar tab: section-hued stroke icon over an 11px label; active gets a tinted chip.
components.css: .ds-tab { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 3px; background: none; border: none; cursor: pointer; padding: 8px 12px; font-family: Outfit, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-tab-icon { display: inline-flex; padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 9px; color: #5b6ea8; } .ds-tab-icon svg { width: 22px; height: 22px; opacity: .72; } .ds-tab-label { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; color: #8a8e80; } .ds-tab-active .ds-tab-icon { background: rgba(91,110,168,.15); } .ds-tab-active .ds-tab-icon svg { opacity: 1; } .ds-tab-active .ds-tab-label { color: #5b6ea8; font-weight: 600; }

narrative.overview: A calm desk by a window: bone paper, warm light, one well-worn reference book. The interface is the desk, not the show — everything on screen serves a pharmacist stealing twenty minutes of study, so the base stays warm and quiet while color appears only where it helps you find your way. The personality is soft and unhurried: generous radii, feather shadows, gentle hover lifts; nothing snaps or shouts. A serif voice (DM Serif Display) gives headings the authority of a bound reference, while a light-weight geometric sans (Outfit) keeps working text modern and effortless.
keyCharacteristics: Warm bone-paper world in both themes (umber dark mode, never slate)
Serif display voice over light sans body
Muted-jewel section spectrum used for wayfinding only
Soft, unhurried components: 12–16px radii, feather shadows, calm ease-out motion
Evidence-based floors: 4.5:1 small-text contrast, 11px functional-text minimum, reduced-motion honored

rules.name: The Wayfinding Rule
rules.body: The section spectrum appears only on icons, chips, and small accents — never on body text and never as a large surface. The base UI stays calm so the color can mean something.

rules.name: The No-Blue Rule
rules.body: There is no neutral blue in this system. Anything drifting toward default SaaS blue (#007AFF, #0d6efd and kin) is a regression, not a choice; the nearest sanctioned hues are the quiz slate-indigo (#5b6ea8) and visuals teal (#4a8aa4).

rules.name: The Serif-Leads Rule
rules.body: Serif for identity moments (page and section headings); sans for everything interactive. Never set controls or body copy in the serif.

rules.name: The Warm Shadow Rule
rules.body: Light-mode shadows are tinted with ink (#2d3428), never pure black — shadow is part of the paper, not soot on it.

dos: Do keep both themes warm: umber darks (#1c1815 family), cream text (#ece4d2) — follow The Warm Shadow Rule.
Do hold small text to 4.5:1 (use Terracotta Ink #a85a38, never raw #cc785c, for small accents on paper) and functional text to the 11px floor.
Do use calm ease-out motion (cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), 0.15–0.3s) and honor prefers-reduced-motion.
Do draw icons as 1.6-stroke SVGs in icon chips; new sections get a new muted-jewel hue defined for both themes.
Do keep canvases at their drawn pixel height — scale the layout, never the bitmap.
donts: Don't introduce neutral blues, grays, or any clinical-SaaS default hue (The No-Blue Rule).
Don't use emoji as UI chrome, thick colored side-borders, colored glow shadows, or overshoot/bounce easings — all were removed deliberately.
Don't put section-spectrum color on body text or large surfaces (The Wayfinding Rule).
Don't add tabs to the main bar; deeper material joins the More hub.
Don't reintroduce login/sync UI or any feature that breaks the static, local-first model.
